description: Suppresses non-critical kernel messages on the host console. Recommended for Firecracker production hosts to avoid console-write latency degrading snapshot restore times.
Reduce kernel log verbosity to KERN_ALERT only. Pairs with `quiet` for minimal serial-console writes. Recommended for Firecracker hosts.
Disable SMT (Hyperthreading) at boot. Required for tenant-separation hosts to mitigate speculation side channels (Spectre, MDS).
Minimum interval between KVM-injected timer interrupts. Higher values reduce kvm-pit kthread CPU overhead but also coarsen APIC timer granularity. Workload-test before raising.
Relative CPU-time weight when CPUs are contended. Per-microVM share calculation: this_share / sum(all_shares_at_this_level). v1; in v2 use cpu.weight.
CFS scheduler period. Combined with cfs_quota_us yields a hard CPU bandwidth cap. v2 equivalent: cpu.max (period/quota pair).
Max CPU time in μs allowed per cfs_period_us window. quota=50000, period=100000 → 50% of one CPU. Hard cap (vs cpu.shares which is a weight).
Hard memory cap. OOM-kills the cgroup if exceeded. v2 equivalent: memory.max.
Memory + swap cap. Required to prevent the OOM killer from being bypassed via swap. v2 equivalent: memory.swap.max + memory.max combined.
Soft cap — only enforced under host memory contention. Lets cgroups use surplus memory normally but reclaims down to the soft limit when other workloads need it. v2 equivalent: memory.high.
0 = stop KSM and unmerge all pages; 1 = run KSM; 2 = stop KSM but keep merged pages. Set to 0 on Firecracker hosts to mitigate page-dedup side channels.
Bound the number of disk I/Os issued by the cgroup. Format: '<major>:<minor> <read_iops> <write_iops>'. v2 equivalent: io.max.
